limestone.name: Sedimentary Limestone
limestone.description: Fine-grained natural limestone slab with subtle porous pitting and delicate sedimentary bedding.
limestone.prompt: Top-down flat-lay macro texture of raw natural fine-grained limestone slab with delicate sedimentary strata and porous mineral pitting.

worn_plaster.name: Worn Lime Plaster
worn_plaster.description: Aged historical lime stucco with delicate hairline drying fissures and soft matte powdery tooth.
worn_plaster.prompt: Top-down flat-lay macro texture of aged worn historical lime stucco wall featuring subtle hairline drying fissures and matte powdery finish.

handmade_paper.name: Handmade Rag Paper
handmade_paper.description: Heavyweight cotton rag paper with organic cellulose fibers, deckle pulp clumps, and micro-creases.
handmade_paper.prompt: Top-down flat-lay macro texture of vintage handmade cotton rag paper with visible cellulose fibers, organic deckle pulp clumps, and micro-creases.

raw_wood.name: Raw Hardwood Timber
raw_wood.description: Planed unvarnished hardwood slab with fine longitudinal grain lines and delicate vascular pores.
raw_wood.prompt: Top-down flat-lay macro texture of fine-grained raw planed hardwood timber slab with natural longitudinal grain lines and delicate vascular pores.

hammered_metal.name: Hammered Patinated Iron
hammered_metal.description: Wrought antique metal plate with rhythmic planishing hammer dimples and dark oxidized patina.
hammered_metal.prompt: Top-down flat-lay macro texture of antique hand-hammered wrought metal plate with rhythmic planishing dimples and dark oxidized bronze-iron patina.

woven_cloth.name: Raw Woven Linen
woven_cloth.description: Coarse unbleached natural linen fabric with interlocking orthogonal warp and weft weave.
woven_cloth.prompt: Top-down flat-lay macro texture of coarse raw natural unbleached linen fabric with interlocking orthogonal warp and weft weave and subtle slub texture.

ornament_rosette.name: Radial Fluted Rosette Relief
ornament_rosette.description: Original 12-fold symmetrical carved rosette medallion with concentric fluted petals in stone.
ornament_rosette.prompt: Top-down flat-lay architectural bas-relief carving of an original 12-fold radial fluted geometric rosette medallion with concentric layered petals.

ornament_palmette.name: Anthemion Palmette Fan Relief
ornament_palmette.description: Original stylized architectural anthemion palmette fan flanked by acanthus volutes in low stone relief.
ornament_palmette.prompt: Top-down orthogonal flat-lay bas-relief stone carving featuring an original symmetrical anthemion palmette fan flanked by acanthus scrollwork.

ornament_meander.name: Stepped Key Meander Relief
ornament_meander.description: Original classical Greek orthogonal key meander fret carved in porous weathered limestone.
ornament_meander.prompt: Top-down flat-lay bas-relief carving of an authentic classical Greek geometric fret meander pattern sculpted in weathered porous limestone.
